data.title: Write your *Instructions* once
data.subtitle: They apply to every conversation you start.

rows.label: Instructions
rows.detail: How you work, your terms, your situations, your tone

composer.text: I work in finance. Write in plain English: short paragraphs, no jargon. Start long answers with a three-line summary. Ask me if something important is missing.

steps: Click your initials, then **Settings → Your Claude**
Write how you work, the terms you use and how Claude should write. Keep it general
data.note: Drawn from Anthropic's help pages, not a screenshot. In the older Settings layout this page is called Account. Your screen may differ.
